notes: brightness 0..255 (LV_LED_BRIGHT_MIN/MAX); on/off is expressed via brightness.
points format: "x1,y1 x2,y2 ..." (pairs space-separated, coords comma-separated; floats accepted, LV_USE_FLOAT=1). Parser owns the point array: freed on re-apply and on widget delete.
Single C setter takes both values at once; parser gathers then calls once. Defaults when only one attr is present: anim_duration=1000 ms, angle=270 deg (constructor defaults).

Pragmatic subset: only RELEASED/PRESSED source states exposed (left/mid/right each). lv_imagebutton_set_src(obj,state,left,mid,right) is called once per state with the gathered parts; missing parts are NULL (mid-only is the common case).

C prefix is lv_animimg_. srcs = space-separated imageRef list (each token resolved via lv_xml_get_image); parser owns the dsc array (freed on re-apply/delete; max 127 frames, pic_count is int8_t). repeat_count also accepts token "infinite" -> LV_ANIM_REPEAT_INFINITE. Defaults: duration=1000 ms, repeat_count=infinite. lv_animimg_start() is called automatically after apply when a source list exists.
title/text are idempotent on re-apply (existing label text is updated instead of adding another). close_button=true adds once (no-op if a header button already exists); false does not remove.
lv_list has no own setters (styled lv_obj). icon on list-button is optional (absent -> NULL -> text-only button).

Simplified model: menu + pages only. menu-page is a container (nested XML children go inside it); title is optional (strdup'd by LVGL). The FIRST page created under a menu is auto-loaded as main page via lv_menu_set_page().

title idempotent on re-apply (first header label updated in place). win-button goes into the header; width default 40 when absent, icon optional. Generic XML children of lv_win land on the win object itself (below header+content), not in the content area.
tileview-tile is a container (nested XML children go inside it). dir accepts '|'-combined tokens (e.g. "left|bottom"); defaults: col=0 row=0 dir=all.

angle_start/angle_size are lv_value_precise_t (float in this build): the parser reads them with lv_xml_atof, so fractional degrees are accepted; declared int here for designer simplicity. text is copied by LVGL.

OVERRIDES the official buffer-less lv_canvas parser. width/height (common obj attrs, PLAIN PX ONLY here, no % / content) additionally size an auto-allocated ARGB8888 draw buffer (default 100x100) which is filled with fill_color (default white, LV_OPA_COVER) so the canvas is visible in the preview. Buffer is parser-owned: recreated on size change, destroyed with the widget. C code emission should use lv_canvas_set_buffer/lv_draw_buf + lv_canvas_fill_bg.

Requires LV_USE_LOTTIE + LV_USE_THORVG_INTERNAL (+ LV_USE_VECTOR_GRAPHIC/LV_USE_MATRIX enabled in this build). src is an imageRef whose registered value must be a MEMFS path to a lottie .json (e.g. "A:assets/anim.json"); unknown refs fall back to using the raw value as a path. A leading "X:" drive prefix is stripped before the thorvg fopen(). width/height (common obj attrs, PLAIN PX ONLY, default 100x100) size the auto-allocated ARGB8888 render buffer (parser-owned, recreated on size change, destroyed with the widget). Animation starts automatically (lv_lottie internal lv_anim, ~60fps, infinite).
